facts.quote: The diet of the Réunion ibis was worms and other items foraged from the soil.

facts.text: Tento druh žil v 17. století v horských oblastech.
facts.quote: In the 17th century, it lived in mountainous areas

facts.text: Tento druh žil jen na sopečném ostrově Réunion v Indickém oceánu.
facts.quote: endemic to the volcanic island of Réunion in the Indian Ocean

facts.text: Tento druh měřil na délku nejvýše asi 65 cm.
facts.quote: It would have been no longer than 65 cm (25 in) in length.

facts.text: Tento druh vyhynul nejpozději na začátku 18. století.
facts.quote: These factors are believed to have driven the Réunion ibis to extinction by the early 18th century.
